subject: How to display console to shiny app

messages.subject: How to display console to shiny app
parts:
Hi,

At one point in my Shiny app, I generate an R markdown document.

Is there a way to show a "wait" or even better a console log of what's going on to the screen while it does this?

Thanks!

messages.author: a814dd0eade31e3e
messages.subject: Re: How to display console to shiny app
parts:
You can wrap the task in withProgress. Take a look at the following 2 pages:

http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/progress.html
http://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/progress-example.html
